role: recovery worker (isolated proposals and reports only)
selection_method: round-13/pick_targets.py (derived from round 12, with every round 1-12 claim address harvested automatically): framed targets only (open with `addiu sp,sp,-N` and containing at least one sd/ld), integer-only (no COP1/CO2, no MULT/DIV premul, no bltz), 20-120 B, unregistered, never attempted by worker B, and not in primary's live claim. Framing is retained because round 6 proved frameless sibling-call thunks are unreproducible on this compiler. This batch deliberately leans on the shapes rounds 9-12 proved productive: the `if (param != 0) { (*(code *)(*(u32 *)DAT + off))(DAT, param); }` dispatcher (0023fe28/00288c20/0028cc40 are siblings of round 12's exact 0023fb90), and small constant-argument forwarders.

range_verification.method: sha256 of each declared range recomputed from the original ELF, cross-checked against /root/kh2fm-build/layout.tsv

compiler_use: shared read-only probe harness only; no flag changes, no stage writes, no docker restart
ownership: worker B owns only files under worker-coordination/worker-b/** and analysis/final-mix/recovery-experiments/fm_worker_b_round13_*; primary owns active sources, functions.tsv, layout.tsv, stage sync, builds, manifests, receipts, Ghidra, HANDOFF.md
acceptance_baseline: 5,512 registered rows observed at pick time; primary's live claim holds 11 addresses and was re-read at pick time to stay disjoint
